systems.system: Harmonised Births and Deaths Registry Portal (HBDRP)
systems.country_label: Harmonised Births and Deaths Registry Portal (HBDRP)
systems.tiers: being rolled out; cited as an illustration of decentralising registration to subnational offices

note: Opinion piece by a former Registrar; it names the portal and its rollout as an example of decentralisation but does not say what the portal does, who enters records in it or in how many offices, so it is unclassified and gives no fact. The African eCRVS Shared Asset it also names is a continental standard, not a system in Ghana.
